# Core Tensor and Error Tests Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement the core integration tests for tensor fundamentals and the unified error model so later domain-specific test files can rely on one validated base layer.

**Architecture:** `tests/test_tensor.rs` covers tensor behavior and aliases. `tests/test_error.rs` covers recoverable error semantics, formatting, safety contracts, and layout boundaries.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std integration tests

**Design Docs:** `design/28-tests.md` §8.1 (tensor tests), §8.20 (error tests), §8.21-§8.23 (boundary and consistency coverage), `design/25-safety.md` §8.2-§8.9 (Send/Sync assertions)

**Prerequisites:** W29T1 must be complete.

---
